groups.rationale: Different network restrictions; hypothetical and completed actions.
Very short instances connecting a named person and a food reference through a shared qualifier.
Activity masks of differing length, with extra actions in only some instances.
Broad and qualified references with contrasting attitudes.
Repeated product references with availability, quantity and making details.
A broad subject alongside narrower event, team and prediction details.

selection: Six complete previously untitled groups from saved coverage-expansion runs; selected for subject/input-structure variety before seeing new model outputs. All have saved valid user grouping decisions. No new clustering, membership or mask edits.
novelty: New groups, not a new independent corpus. Some source notes/masks appeared in earlier experiments. Exclude exact member-set and fragment-multiset matches to prior title probes; no expected titles supplied.
assessment: Review every title against all exact masks under the unchanged shared-subject and independent-support requirement. No unique expected label. Distinguish subject categories from assertions; assess broadness, unsupported restrictions, text-form labels, and format failures without assuming each existing group admits a useful title.
execution: First call alone; then at most three concurrent. Fresh process/thread/empty workspace per call, no extra examples or context. Stop new calls on error, no automatic retries or best-of.
scope: No prompt/model edits, no Sol retest, no freeze, no hierarchy changes.
billing: Authorized Codex subscription only; no new API billing, purchases, rentals or financial commitment.
